pairs.registryProposal: The subject could state its boundary against app-owned 'shared instructions' fields in the same terms it uses against prompt-assembly. A reader could otherwise take a user-authored, always-delivered team instruction blob for an instruction file, even though line-earning, freshness and restraint balance arguably carry over to it.
